tests.reason: Untestable (no way): VS Code 1.142.0 on macOS offers no read of a terminal cell or its link. The extension API's Terminal interface (src/vscode-dts/vscode.d.ts:7672-7683 at tag 1.142.0) carries name, processId, creationOptions, exitStatus, state, shellIntegration and send/show/hide/dispose; TerminalShellExecution.read() (:7770-7780) is command output as plain text. The proposed terminalSelection API returns plain text and terminalDataWriteEvent echoes the data written to the terminal, which is the probe's own input and cannot show what the app stored. The renderer's link layer needs a --remote-debugging-port launch, which is not a default-launch reader, and its hover tooltip needs a pointer the owned-host no-input rule forbids. OSC 8 has no query form, and the plain probe only reads the cursor, which cannot verify link metadata. This records the observation surface, not whether the app stores the link.
